name: agent-board
description: A pane that shows what every subagent is working on, in this session and in every other session that runs the plugin: task, type, status, last tool, elapsed time.

gistId.description: Id of the private GitHub Gist used as the shared store (the hex id in the gist URL). Leave empty to run single-session only.

githubToken.description: Fine-grained GitHub token with Gists read and write. Stored in secure storage.
githubToken.title: GitHub token
